QUOTE: The library itself never calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`. The index shows exactly one caller: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`). That is the bundled fixed-buffer allocator, and it is the only in-library user of the hook.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator's init function as the sole caller of the setter, installing its own calloc/free pointers. It doesn't cite the MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C macro, but the mechanism and location are clearly stated.
